decisions.reason: As a newly launched camera close to the core business and publicly presented on its own page, it fits the firm's stated direction and prior investment makes withdrawal unlikely.
This modular camera line is highly aligned with the firm's move toward compact and flexible sensors, and the visible launch of several models increases commitment to continue.

The sensor suite builds on established capabilities and supports future space operations, so in a growing R&D-intensive market management is likely to attribute any early issues to normal ramp-up rather than abandon it.

Although website commitment was weaker because it was only mentioned rather than fully featured, its miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR concept still matches the firm's technology base and strategic direction, so it is more likely to be retained than dropped.
